Outlines are tinted blue-grey (0% near-neutral), so they read as material tone, not sticker black. The lower ground strip is a large flat fill with no grain, speckle or stones, and the step faces are mostly smooth. Measured values give 7 visible tones per tile, matching the paving reference but well above the grass at 3, with 20% near-flat coverage against 0% for both references. The 7 tones come from many thin accent lines and sparse snow dots, not from rich surface texture, and the references have texture across the whole tile. The picture shows the candidate is flatter and simpler than the references, so it would look thinner beside them. The flat-fill share and shallow ramps are enough to fail.
